page.layout: One page of text, single column, no margin notes. Running head top centre, page number top right. Verse lines (the epigram) set indented in italics. Gathering signature at bottom right.

main_text.p: ac aggrauent, necnon densissimas imperita multitudinis oculis offucias offundant, eámque miserè technis suis circumueniant, dum scilicet hæc falsò opinatur, sibique persuadet stolidè nulli tutius, facilíusque concredi posse vitam, salutè, ac sanitatem corporis, atque illis, qui titulo Doctoris superbiunt, magnificéque se efferunt, necnon splendidissima suo ære emendicata testimonia superciliosè aliis osten-tant. Quæ interdum ita sunt comparata, ut si ea perlegas, sanctè iurare ausis, te nullum unquam excellentiorem vidisse Doctorem. Cùm tamen non raro lateat anguis in herba, & detracta pelle leonina, demptisque hisce hyperbolicis encomiis, Asinus Cumanus in prospectum prodeat. Un Allemand tres-doctè se mocque de ces Docteurs bullez, Doctores bullati, siue Codicillares, par un Epigramme fort elegant,

p.i: Doctorem te bulla creat, tibi Bulla decori est, Bulla tibi vires, bulla parit titulos: Sed caveas ne forte nimis te bulla perennet, Bulla homo es, & Doctor, bulla quid ergo tumes?

main_text.p: Examinons si le terme de fix m ois est suffisant pour estudier en Medecine, & former un Docteur pour aller pratiquer la Medecine, hic & ubique Terrarum. Ceux qui demeurent un an à Montpelier, sont fort rares. Il y en a plus qui ne demeurent que le temps qu'il faut aux petits oiseaux pour

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "fix m ois" (spacing and form as printed; likely "six mois"), "technis" (the word breaks across lines as "te-" / "chnis"), "salutè", "oftentant" printed with a hyphen at the line end ("osten-tant"). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The scan is slightly faded at the top right and some words in the first lines are doubtful. No marginal notes on this page.
